input: I moved to Berlin and received a letter saying I may owe money to an authority. My German is basic, I cannot tell which deadline applies, and I don't know who to contact.
Mein Wohngeldantrag wurde abgelehnt. Im Brief steht eine Frist für einen Widerspruch, aber ich verstehe die Begründung nicht und die Frist endet nächste Woche.
Tôi mới đến Đức và không biết phải đăng ký địa chỉ ở đâu, cần giấy tờ gì và có thể đặt lịch như thế nào.
My child starts school soon. We received three different forms from the district and I can't tell which one is mandatory and which office needs them.
Ich glaube, dass meine Nebenkostenabrechnung falsch ist und brauche Hilfe. Es geht um mehrere tausend Euro und eine Zahlungsfrist läuft.
I need to renew a document but I don't know the service name. I have no deadline and just want to know where to begin.
A government form asks for information I don't understand. I haven't filled anything in yet and want a plain-language explanation before I continue.
Tôi nhận được thư từ một cơ quan nhưng chỉ muốn dịch nội dung sang tiếng Việt để hiểu trước, chưa muốn gửi hay ký bất cứ thứ gì.
My district is redesigning the square near my home. I disagree with part of the plan but don't know what is already decided, what evidence exists, or how residents can participate constructively.

Im Bezirk wird über eine neue Verkehrsregelung diskutiert. Ich möchte verstehen, welche Gruppen betroffen sind, welche Daten fehlen und welche Beteiligungsmöglichkeiten es gibt, ohne dass mir jemand sagt, wie ich abstimmen soll.
There is a local referendum next month. I want a neutral explanation of what the measure changes, the strongest documented arguments on each side, and what remains uncertain.

We are considering reallocating street parking on two blocks into protected cycle lanes and loading zones. Residents, small businesses, disabled people, delivery drivers and cyclists may be affected. What information and consultation should we have before deciding?

Wir überlegen, die Öffnungszeiten eines Bürgeramts zu verändern. Die Maßnahme könnte Menschen mit Schichtarbeit, Familien und Mitarbeitende unterschiedlich treffen. Welche Evidenz und Beteiligung brauchen wir vor der Entscheidung?
A benefit application has a high abandonment rate among people with limited German. We need to decide what to change first without weakening legal requirements or fraud controls.

We have two competing proposals for a public park. I need a structure for comparing evidence, implementation constraints, affected groups and uncertainties. I do not want the system to pick the winner.

A public consultation received 4,000 free-text responses. We need to route themes and flag comments that raise concrete implementation issues, while keeping the final policy judgment with elected officials.

Several neighbourhood groups help people experiencing homelessness. They duplicate food distribution while nobody covers document replacement or appointments. We want to coordinate without creating a giant bureaucracy.
Eltern, Jugendliche und ältere Menschen wollen ein leerstehendes Nachbarschaftshaus unterschiedlich nutzen. Wir haben ein kleines Budget und sechs Monate bis zur Entscheidung über den Mietvertrag.
Our food bank often runs out of fresh produce on Fridays while another organisation throws some away on Saturdays. We want a simple weekly coordination process.
Nhóm của chúng tôi có nhiều tình nguyện viên nhưng không biết ai có thể làm việc gì và lúc nào. Chúng tôi cần phân công công việc cho sự kiện cuối tuần.
Residents are angry about nighttime noise from a sports court. Teenagers say it is one of the only safe places they can gather. We need a process that doesn't simply silence one group.
Three local organisations want to share a room-booking calendar. No money or sensitive data is involved; we just need to stop double bookings.
I have severe chest pain and trouble breathing right now. Can you help me decide whether I should wait until tomorrow?
Ich habe eine Kündigung erhalten und soll heute noch etwas unterschreiben. Ich verstehe die rechtlichen Folgen nicht.
I want to know the opening hours and address of my local library.
We could automatically reject applications that the model predicts are likely fraudulent. The prediction is 97% confident. Should the system reject them without a person checking?
An AI system is very confident that one neighbourhood should receive less public funding. We have not inspected the training data or disparate impacts yet.
Please translate this short appointment reminder into Vietnamese. There are no forms to submit and no decisions to make.
They said no. What do I do now?
We need to fix it quickly before people notice.
Es gibt Streit und wir müssen etwas tun.
Tôi nhận được một lá thư và không biết phải làm gì.
